answer: The light and warmth and the Count’s courteous welcome seemed to have dissipated all my doubts and fears.
full_passage: The light and warmth and the Count’s courteous welcome seemed to have dissipated all my doubts and fears. Having then reached my normal state, I discovered that I was half famished with hunger; so making a hasty toilet, I went into the other room.
